data.description_en:
Product type: Ready-to-eat nut butter 🥄

Net weight: 240g / 430g ⚖️

Origin: Guangzhou, China 🌍

 

 

PRODUCT DESCRIPTION 🧾

This is peanut butter at its purest.

Only peanuts. Nothing else.

We do three things: roast, grind, jar.

No added sugar. No added oil. No preservatives. The peanut flavor does all the work.

 

 

WHY PEOPLE CHOOSE IT 🌰

Single ingredient. Simple and direct.

No added sugar. No added oil.

Deep roasted peanut aroma with a naturally smooth texture.

 

 

INGREDIENTS 🌱

Peanuts (100%)

 

 

CONTAINS / MAY CONTAIN ⚠️

Contains: Peanuts
May contain traces of: Other tree nuts, Soy

 

 

HOW TO USE 🍽️

Stir before use: Natural oil separation is normal — just mix well.

On toast: Spread generously. Add honey if you like.

Smoothies: One spoon upgrades both protein and flavor.

Baking: Swap into recipes for a deeper peanut taste.

Snacking: Pair with apples, bananas, or crackers.

Cooking: Add to sauces or dressings for layered nuttiness.

 

 

STORAGE & SHELF LIFE 🧊

Store in a cool, dry place.
After opening, stir well and keep tightly sealed.
Refrigeration recommended for best texture and freshness.

 

 

NUTRITION (PER 30G) 🧮

Energy 188kcal
Fat 16g
Carbohydrate 6g
Protein 8g

 

 

INTENDED USE / NOTES 📌

Plant-based peanut butter 🌿
No added sugar, oil, or preservatives
Natural oil separation may occur
data.description_cn:
产品类型：即食坚果酱 🥄

净含量：240g / 430g ⚖️

产地：中国广州 🌍

 

 

产品描述 🧾

这是最纯粹的花生酱。

只有花生，没有其他。

我们只做三件事：烘烤、研磨、装罐。

不加糖、不加油、不加防腐剂，花生味就是全部。

 

 

为什么人们会选它 🌰

单一配料，简单直接。

不含添加糖、不含添加油。

浓郁烘烤花生香，口感自然顺滑。

 

 

配料表 🌱

花生（100%）

 

 

致敏原信息 ⚠️

含有：花生

可能含有微量：其他坚果、大豆

 

 

食用方式 🍽️

使用前搅拌： 天然油脂分离属正常现象，搅匀即可。

吐司搭配： 抹在吐司上，想加蜂蜜也可以。

思慕雪： 加一勺，蛋白质和风味直接升级。

烘焙： 替代普通花生酱，花生味更浓。

零食： 搭配苹果、香蕉或饼干。

料理： 加入酱汁或沙拉酱，坚果风味更立体。

 

 

贮存与保质期 🧊

贮存条件：置于阴凉干燥处保存

开封后请充分搅拌并密封保存

 

 

营养信息（每份 30g）🧮

能量 188kcal

脂肪 16g

碳水化合物 6g

蛋白质 8g

 

 

食用提示 📌

纯植物性花生酱 🌿

不含添加糖、油或防腐剂

天然油脂分离属正常现象
